description: This Java class 'UtilPlist' provides utility methods for writing property list (plist) files in both XML and non-XML formats, supporting nested maps and lists, and including functionality for writing model information in Apple's EOModelBundle format.

classes.name: UtilPlist
classes.description: Final utility class for writing property list files in XML or plain format, supporting nested structures and Apple EOModelBundle format.

methods.name: writePlistProperty
methods.description: Writes a property with a given name and value, handling nested maps and lists.

methods.name: writePlistPropertyMap
methods.description: Writes a map of properties in plist format, with optional comma separation.

methods.name: writePlistPropertyValueList
methods.description: Writes a list of property values in plist format.

methods.name: writePlistPropertyXml
methods.description: Writes a property in XML plist format.

methods.name: writePlistPropertyMapXml
methods.description: Writes a map in XML plist format.

methods.name: writePlistPropertyValueListXml
methods.description: Writes a list of values in XML plist format.

methods.name: writePlistFile
methods.description: Writes a complete plist file in either XML or binary format, supporting nested structures and EOModelBundle format.
